text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
BANGLADESH, Chittagong, May 27 - Berthing delays general cargo vessels one to four days.

INDIA, May 27 - Bombay delays - containers 1-2 days, bulk vessels 5-6 days, general cargo 1-2 days. 9 vessels loading at berth. 21 discharging at berth. 2 vessels discharging at anchorage. 4 waiting at anchorage to load. 10 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 3 vessels under repairs. 3 awaiting orders. Gang shortage due to summer vacation. Floating crane laid up for indefinite period.

Calcutta - 22 vessels due of which 2 coking coal, 5 product tankers, 6 containers, 1 general, 2 crude, 3 coal, 1 petcoke, 1 lash barge, 1 soda ash. 7 vessels loading at berth. 18 discharging at berth. 1 bunkering.
Cochin - nine vessels due. Up to 1 days delay expected. 2 vessels loading at berth. 7 discharging at berth. 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 4 under repairs/drydock.

Madras - 32 vessels due (1 coal, 1 iron ore, 1 fertiliser, 10 general, 8 containers, 2 logs, 1 palm oil, 3 granite blocks. Delays expected, coal/coke, fertiliser 2-3 days, scrap 4-5 days, iron ore 5-6 days, others 2-3 days. 1 vessel loading at berth. 9 discharging at berth.

Mormugao - five ore vessels due. 4-5 days delay expected. 2 other vessels due. Up to 1 days delay expected. Vessel loading at berth. 7 loading at anchorage. 3 discharging at berth. 11 waiting at anchorage to load. 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 4 under repairs/drydock. 1 awaiting orders.

Kandla - 11 vessels due. 15-16 days delay expected. 3 loading at berth. 10 waiting to load. 6 discharging at berth. 2 discharging in stream. 9 awaiting berth for discharging. 2 arrested in port. 3 tankers. 14 vessels waiting.
Mangalore - ten vessels due. 2-3 days delay expected. 8 vessels loading/discharging at berth. 1 awaiting at berth. 1 arrested.

Jawaharlal Nehru - vessels due, 1 urea, 1 DAP, 4 tankers/iron ore vessels. Delays expected, 6 days urea, 10 days other fertiliser, 6 days tankers/iron ore vessels. 1 tanker loading at berth. 2 vessels discharging at berth (fertiliser/raw material/food grain). 1 iron ore discharging at anchorage. 1 fertiliser/raw material/foodgrain waiting at anchorage to discharge. Bulk berth no. 4 not available from 1/6 to 30/9.
Paradip - six vessels due. 14 days delay expected. 2 vessels loading at berth. 1 discharging at berth. 5 waiting at anchorage to discharge.
Tuticorin - eight vessels due. 2-3 days delay. 3 loading at berth. 1 loading at anchorage. 7 discharging at berth. 1 waiting at anchorage to load. 5 waiting at anchorage to discharge.
Visakhapnam - 22 vessels due. 7-8 days delay expected. 6 loading at berth. 7 discharging at berth. 8 waiting at anchorage to load at inner harbour berth. 6 other vessels.

SOUTH KOREA, May 27 - Inchon - seventy-seven vessels in port (46 berthed, 31 anchored) of which 11 logs, 5 corn, 4 general cargo, 3 each pig iron, scrap, containers, 2 each raw sugar, cars, 1 each molasses, talc, cement, cotton seed meal, pipes, rape seed meal, alfalfa, bananas, coils, steel, silica sand, wheat, pulp. Anchored 4 each scrap, corn, general cargo, coils, 3 each logs, containers, 2 each wheat, cars, 1 each maize, soybean meal, soda, pig iron, wheat blending pellets. Approx. 1-2 days delay expected.

Busan - one hundred and fifty-six vessels in port (45 berthed, 111 anchored including 56 laid up) of which 29 general cargo, 8 container vessels, 4 each scrap, coal. 55 vessels awaiting berth with approx. 1-2 days delay expected. Pohang - seventeen vessels berthed of which discharging 6 steel products, 3 scrap, 1 logs. 7 vessels loading steel. No berthing delays expected.

Ulsan - twenty-three vessels berthed of which discharging 2 each mono ethyl glycol, woodchips, steel pipes, 1 each soda ash, coils, base oil, feed meal, caustic soda, rock phosphate, zinc concentrates, copper concentrates, crude oil, corn, Busan, May 29 -- berth congestion situation/berthing delay at South Korean ports, Busan - one hundred and forty-two vessels in port, 60 at berths and 82 at anchorage. Delay usually two to three days due to berth congestion. Ulsan - forty-nine vessels in port, 24 at berths and 25 at anchorage. No delays. Pohang - forty-eight vessels in port, 36 at berths and 12 at anchorage. No delays. Inchon - eighty-five vessels in port, 60 at berths and 25 at anchorage. Delay one to two days due to berth congestion.

MALAYSIA, May 28 - Port Keelang - north/south port container/ro/ro berth 7 vessels alongside. 9 vessels waiting. 1 days waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf 3 vessels alongside, 1 vessel berthed, 1 vessel waiting, 1 days waiting time. Dry/cement bulk terminal 2 vessels alongside, 6 vessels waiting, 6 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal 4 vessels alongside, 6 vessels waiting, 1 days waiting time.

West port container/ro/ro berth 1 vessel alongside, no vessels waiting, no waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 6 vessels alongside, 2 vessels waiting, 2 days waiting time. Cement bulk terminal 1 vessel alongside. No vessels waiting. 4 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - no vessels.

MAURITIUS, Port Louis - May 27 - three container vessels alongside discharging/loading. 2 container vessels at outer anchorage awaiting berth. 1 car carrier, 1 general cargo, 1 bulk wheat discharging alongside. No idle vessels. 1 vessels in drydock. Port working normally.

PAKISTAN, May 26, Karachi - seven vessels due. Delays expected 1 day for general cargo. 3 days for tankers. 4 vessels loading rice at berth. 3 containers loading and discharging at berth. 8 vessels discharging at berth (logs, general cargo, phosphate, oil). 6 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (containers, tanker, gas oil, chemical, fuel oil, crude oil). 1 vessel under repairs/drydock. 1 vessel awaiting orders. Port Qasim - seven vessels discharging at berth (sugar, jute, project cargo, iron ore, fuel oil). 2 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (sugar and fuel oil).

SINGAPORE, May 26 - Tanjong Pagar container terminal, 9 container vessels berthed. Keppel, 8 container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang, 11 container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang, 1 general cargo berthed. Jurong, 9 bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminal/SBM buoys, 23 tankers berthed. Minimum delays at all facilities.

SRI LANKA, May 27 - Colombo - 26 vessels due (container/feeders). Delays general cargo 4-5 days, bagged sugar 15-18 days, bagged onions 3-4 days, container (feeder) 1-2 days. 12 vessels loading at berth of which 3 essential services, 9 containers. Discharging at berth 5 bagged sugar, 9 containers, 1 wheat flour, 1 bagged urea/cement, 1 LPG, 1 bagged urea, general cargo. 12 vessels waiting at anchorage to load of which 11 containers (feeders), 1 general cargo. Waiting at anchorage to discharge 1 bagged sugar, 11 containers (feeders), 1 bagged fertiliser, 2 bagged cement, 1 bagged wheat flour. 6 vessels bunkering. 1 under repairs. 7 dry-docked. 6 awaiting orders. 1 crew change.

Labour shortage continues. Port unable to provide maximum gangs. Berthing delays on breakbulk conventional vessels. Galle - no vessels. Trincomalee - two vessels discharging at berth. 1 loading at berth.
